r = await world.call('repo.shell', command='''python -c "
import arrow
from datetime import datetime

a = arrow.Arrow.fromdatetime(datetime(2023, 2, 12, 2, 30), tzinfo='US/Eastern')
b = arrow.Arrow.fromdatetime(datetime(2023, 3, 12, 2, 30), tzinfo='US/Eastern')

# Simulate humanize logic
dt = b._datetime
self_dt = a._datetime
sign = -1 if dt < self_dt else 1
print('sign:', sign)

approx_months = abs((dt.year * 12 + dt.month) - (self_dt.year * 12 + self_dt.month))
print('approx_months:', approx_months)

if approx_months == 1:
    months_count = 1
    if sign == -1:
        shifted = a.shift(months=months_count, check_imaginary=False)
        print('shifted (sign=-1):', shifted)
        print('shifted._datetime <= dt:', shifted._datetime <= dt)
    else:
        shifted = a.shift(months=-months_count, check_imaginary=False)
        print('shifted (sign=1):', shifted)
        print('shifted._datetime >= dt:', shifted._datetime >= dt)"''')
